purpose: Strict network-only unseen-family future forecasting with clean pre-attack history and event-level lead time.
dataset_family: ToN-IoT network traffic with timestamp-preserving source and security-event-compatible labels

temporal_protocol.clean_history_definition: No attack-labelled network window of any family in the complete preceding 8-minute history.
temporal_protocol.positive_definition: A held-out-family event begins after the cutoff and within the stated future horizon; held-out-family examples are absent from train/calibration/policy.
temporal_protocol.negative_definition: Complete clean future horizon with no attack label and complete 8-minute benign history.
temporal_protocol.split_rule: Time/campaign disjoint. All windows overlapping a held-out-family campaign are excluded from train, calibration, and policy.
temporal_protocol.threshold_rule: Threshold selected only on policy benign/known-development traffic to meet the frozen FPR budget; final validation is never used for threshold selection.

allowed_feature_classes: topology counts/fanout/concentration without raw IP identity

final_claim_gate.claim_if_passed: Garuda demonstrated future warning on attack families excluded from model development, with measured clean-history lead time.
